newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish FinMin not worried by softer crown.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin not worried by softer crown.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink on Friday dismissed worries about the softening crown.
"I do not have great worries about the crown," Asbrink told journalists after a meeting with the parliament's EU committee.
"A slow crown softening has been going on since the autumn of 1996. With an inflation target and a floating crown this is something you have to be prepared for."
The crown has weakened to 4.5370 against the mark on Friday, from 4.4133 in September, 1996.
